title: Real integrals
summary: Specify the integral laws, then construct finite enclosures and justified improper limits for the function at hand.
status: Construction guide; each example records its own checked scope

title: Complex path integrals
summary: Integrate along paths using constants times displacements, with linearity, path addition, and quantitative comparisons.
status: Construction guide; finite geometric computations and semantic bridges are distinguished

title: Series
summary: Define a sum through its ordered partial sums and compute it with finite tail estimates and explicit error budgets.
status: Construction guide; convergence and closed-form identification require separate evidence

title: Holomorphic functions
summary: Choose finite remainder estimates, series, integrals, local equations, or reflected charts and construct the required evidence.
status: Construction guide; affine, square, reflection, and coherent-chart realization are checked

title: Analytic continuation
summary: Continue a germ by Taylor chains, functional equations, reflection, or local uniqueness, proving overlap agreement along the route.
status: Construction guide; general identity and monodromy theorems remain open
